legal_name: Shriram Pistons & Rings Limited (per Screener/BSE-NSE listing the company is now shown as 'SPR Auto Technologies Ltd', BSE: 544344, NSE: SHRIPISTON; the rename could not be confirmed against an MCA record in this session, so the exact current registered name is unverified)
revenue_source: Screener.in consolidated P&L (Mar 2025: 3,550 Cr; Mar 2026: 4,459 Cr), derived from the company's audited consolidated results filed with BSE/NSE (BSE: 544344, NSE: SHRIPISTON). Standalone figures for the same years: 3,180 Cr (FY25) and 3,527 Cr (FY26).
note: Registry identifiers not verified: DuckDuckGo search backend was unreachable (connection refused) and registry aggregators (Zaubacorp, TheCompanyCheck, EMIS) returned 403/410, so CIN, PAN, GSTIN, GST status, incorporation date, registered-office state and MCA status are all null rather than guessed. What IS confirmed from a public filing-derived source (Screener.in, which mirrors BSE/NSE disclosures): the entity is an actively listed, going concern with 14 manufacturing plants (Mar 2026) producing pistons, piston pins, piston rings and engine valves for domestic and export automotive markets — hence role = manufacturer, not trader. Note the listing now appears under the name 'SPR Auto Technologies Ltd' with the same NSE symbol SHRIPISTON and website shrirampistons.com, indicating a corporate name change; this should be re-checked against the MCA master data before use. No rejection grounds found: the entity exists and is listed/operating. Industry claim 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy/mining) is imprecise — actual activity is automotive components manufacturing (HS 840991 piston/engine parts is consistent with the product line). Revenue figures are consolidated group figures and include subsidiaries (SPR Takahata, SPR TGPEL, SPR EMF Innovations, Antolin entities acquired Jan 2026); standalone parent-only revenue is lower as noted.
